body.message: Hi, message for the fam Living leadership team. Running the holiday-homes arm of a major brokerage usually means juggling the parent company's systems plus a separate STR stack: PMS, channel managers, WhatsApp, spreadsheets. Base360 replaces the pile with one system: unified guest inbox, AI agents doing the repetitive work, cleaning and finance connected. Built by The Flex's founders (650+ units). Live 30-min founder demo next week. Who's the right person?
